channel.title: Cane and Rinse network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cane and Rinse network (caneandrinse.com)

item.title: Rescue on Fractalus! - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: One of the first games out of Lucasfilm's freshly-formed games studio, Rescue on Fractalus! was - if nothing else - a technical tour de force in its day.

item.title: Sin and Punishment - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: Leon, Chris W., Michiel, Ryan and guest Mark MSX of The Electric Underground dissect Treasure's Sin and Punishment in the usual Cane and Rinse fashion

item.title: Turrican - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: Buttery-smooth 8-way scrolling and 1300 screens of run and gun platform shoot-'em up action on 8 or 16-bit. That was the promise delivered upon by Rainbow Arts' Turrican in 1990.

item.title: Black Myth: Wukong - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: We hop aboard our magic flying clouds to batter our way through Chinese studio Game Science's mighty smash, Black Myth: Wukong.

item.title: Time Crisis - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast returns for its fifteen year with its first ever lightgun game coverage, Namco's celebrated Time Crisis.

item.title: Please, Touch The Artwork - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: We head to the gallery for post-impressionist puzzles in these digital explorations of Piet Mondrian and James Ensor

item.title: Defender and Stargate - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: Julian 'Jaz' Rignall joins us as special guest for this 45th anniversary celebration of Williams' Defender, and its sequel, Stargate

item.title: Rollcage and Rollcage Stage II - The Cane and Rinse podcast
item.description: Join us as we discuss the cult racer, Rollcage, its impact on the late-90s gaming landscape, and its legacy.

item.title: Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: We postulate on Konami Kobe's first and second attempts at turning the resolutely side-on world of Demon Castle Dracula into polygons.

item.title: Balan Wonderworld - The Cane and Rinse videogame podcast
item.description: It’s time for a show! Join us as we explore the wild and sometimes confusing world of Square Enix’s notorious Balan Wonderworld.
